# #467 Fed, Buffett & prenumerationsmodellen

**Feed**: avanzapodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-22  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode #467 of the Avanza podcast covers the Fed's first rate hike in three years (25bp, as expected), Riksbank rate-hike odds, and a broadly optimistic view that Nordic indices will end the year higher on a hoped-for strong earnings season. It reflects on Warren Buffett stepping down to honorary chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, a long thematic discussion of spin-offs/serial acquirers, consumer subscription economics and shareholder discounts, and closes with an Affärsvärlden/Placera analysis of Munters.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 MTRS — Munters | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Placera/Affärsvärlden set a 'chilly' neutral rating: exploding datacenter order book (SEK 25bn vs SEK 15bn sales) offset by debt at 3.2x EBITDA and margin uncertainty.

#### Reasoning

Analysts see a huge datacenter-driven order book (>3x current datacenter sales) but flag execution and profitability risk on the large projects, a Virginia factory with component-shortage cost drag (~3pp gross margin in tariffs), net debt above the 1.5-2.5x target forcing a halt to M&A, and a foodtech divestment now aimed at cutting debt. Stock is down 22% YTD; view is balanced, hence neutral/hold.

#### Sell Triggers

- if datacenter project margins disappoint on delivery
- if net debt is not reduced toward the 1.5-2.5x target
- if the Virginia factory ramp/component supply fails to normalize
- if the datacenter order intake slows

> *"Får man säga att ni har satt ett kyligt neutralt råd på det här bolaget? Det kan man nog säga."*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

New external CEO Klaus Zellmer (ex-Skoda) announced via a Sunday press release; analysts saw Samuelsson stepping down as expected; stock up ~2% on the news.

#### Reasoning

The CEO transition was widely anticipated, and the market reacted positively (+2%) to the well-communicated Sunday announcement; hosts view the orderly succession favorably though note surprise at an external rather than internal appointment. No formal recommendation, only a mildly constructive read on the leadership change.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the new CEO signals a strategy shift the market dislikes
- if subsequent quarterly deliveries/margins disappoint

> *"Aktien är upp nästan 2% på det här beskedet idag. Det får man ju säga starkt."*

---

### 🟡 BRK-B — Berkshire Hathaway | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Buffett moves to honorary chairman with son Howard overseeing continuity; Buffett says he has never felt more secure about the future; hosts semi-jokingly call it a buy signal.

#### Reasoning

Hosts highlight Berkshire's ~20% annualized return since 1965 and Buffett's stated confidence, plus a ~50% increase in the Alphabet stake signaling conviction from Abel/Buffett. The succession is framed as sensibly bedded down early, but the commentary is celebratory/speculative rather than a firm recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the leadership succession disrupts capital-allocation discipline
- if Buffett's departure signals undisclosed problems

> *"han aldrig har känt sig mer trygg inför det som väntar härnäst... Jag vet inte om vi ska plocka upp det som en liten köpsignal"*
